name: Redcap Breaker
descr: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

data.motivesAndTactics: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

features.name: Backbreaker
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **3d4+10** physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is _Restrained_ until they clear a HP.

features.name: Kneecapper
features.text: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target temporarily _Vulnerable._
